description: Decode EVM function selectors, calldata and event topics: looks up 4-byte selectors (or 32-byte event topics) in 4byte.directory plus a built-in table of well-known signatures, re-hashes every candidate with Keccak-256 to drop bad entries, and for full calldata ABI-decodes the arguments (address with EIP-55 checksum, uint/int as exact decimal strings, bool, bytes, string, arrays, tuples), ranking candidates that decode cleanly first. Also computes the selector/topic for a given signature. Price: $0.005 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/evm-selector-decode

calldata.description: Full transaction input data (0x...), decoded against the candidates

signature.description: A signature like transfer(address,uint256) to hash into its selector/topic

name: evm_selector_decode
title: Evm Selector Decode
